newsitem.title: USA: Arizona bathroom boa clogs woman's plumbing.
newsitem.headline: Arizona bathroom boa clogs woman's plumbing.

text.p: An Arizona woman flushed her toilet and had the scare of her life -- she came face to face with a 6-foot boa constrictor.

When Jona Giammalva noticed the toilet was blocked on Tuesday she thought it was a toy or a wad of paper one of her toddlers had dumped in the bowl. But none of the usual remedies -- drain cleaner, wire coat hanger, plunger -- seemed to work.
That was when Giammalva tried to flush it one more time and there, staring up at her, was the large snake.
"I was out of there in a split second," she told Reuters on Wednesday. "I wasn't about to waste any time."

She called 911, the national number for emergencies. They suggested she shut the door and police gave her the name of a wildlife expert who could help her remove the snake. Reptile remover Chere Gruver grabbed the bathroom boa -- dubbed Johnny -- and took it to a veterinarian.
Gruver told Giammalva the snake probably was a pet that somehow got into the sewer system in this Phoenix suburb.
